description_en: Open-source, low-cost 10.5 GHz PLFM phased array RADAR system
readme_excerpt: AERIS-10: Open Source Pulse Linear Frequency Modulated Phased Array Radar AERIS-10 is an open-source, low-cost 10.5 GHz phased array radar system featuring Pulse Linear Frequency Modulated (LFM) modulation.
